definitions.full: H6959. qoba קוֺבַע noun [masculine] helmet (word of peculiar form, and dubious √; probably foreign word; compare Ethiopic turban, tiara, cowl , so Syriac ; קוֺבְעָא ᵑ7 turban ); — absolute ׳ק Ezek 23:24 ; construct נְחשֶׁת ק֫וֺבַע 1Sam 17:38 . — compare also כּוֺבַע .

occurrences.englishText: Saul dressed David with his clothing. He put a helmet of bronze on his head, and he clad him with a coat of mail.

They will come against you with weapons, chariots, and wagons, and with a company of peoples. They will set themselves against you with buckler, shield, and helmet all around. I will commit the judgment to them, and they will judge you according to their judgments.
